content:
Alongside ongoing all-time lows on the base models at nearly $200 off, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the 16GB/1TB and the 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air models hitting new Amazon low pricing today at $199 off. We also have Apple’s base 1TB M5 MacBook Pro back at the $1,499 Amazon all-time low still, a chance to land a new set of Apple’s most affordable AirPods 4 for the summer at nearly 25% off, and the latest Apple Magic Mouse at Amazon all-time low pricing. Those deals join Anker’s 25W Qi2 MagSafe car mount and this Spigen Trail Loop-style Watch band at $20. Head below for a closer look at the details.

M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB model hits Amazon low pricing today at $199 off, more up to $260 off

Just after catching the 16GB/1TB as well as the base model at the new Amazon all-time low, we are also now seeing the Midnight and Silver 24GB model at the best Amazon price ever this morning – it is now $199 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB SSD down at $1,299.99 shipped.

Regularly $1,499, this is $199 off the list price and the lowest price we have tracked to date on this 24GB/1TB configuration. As of right now, this deal is only live on the Midnight and Silver colorways, but we will be monitoring the listing all day for the other two.

Unlike the base model at $900 and the 16GB/1TB, both at nearly $200 off, this 24GB model featured above has some competition right now in the form of a recent B&H offer:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,300 (Reg. $1,499) | Amazon all-time low
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/512GB from $1,249 (Reg. $1,519) | B&H
  • With 35W Dual USB-C Port Power Adapter (worth $20)

While clearly not the same configuration, folks looking towards the 24GB of RAM that aren’t set on the 1TB storage have some considerations to make here. With the B&H offer you’re saving an additional $50 out of pocket, but you’re landing half the internal storage. You are also getting the bonus charger “upgrade” worth $20 – it is a slower charger, but it has two USB-C ports on it.

Either way, the M5 MacBook Air deals are, largely, better than they ever have been on most configs right now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $900 (Reg. $1,099) – Amazon all-time low
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,100 (Reg. $1,299) – Amazon all-time low
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,300 (Reg. $1,499) – Amazon all-time low
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,100 (Reg. $1,299) – Amazon all-time low
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699)

Apple’s 16GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air just hit a new Amazon all-time low at nearly $200 off

Land a new set of Apple’s most affordable AirPods 4 for the summer at nearly 25% off

While the Memorial AirPods Pro 3 deal has jumped up $29 now, Amazon has decided to bring back the nearly 25% price drop on the much more affordable current-gen AirPods 4 at $99.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s latest AirPods 4 down at $99 shipped.

Regularly $129, this is approaching 25% off the list price and the lowest we can find. This deal is on par with the Memorial Day sale price, as well as the offer we tracked during the Big Spring Sale before that. It is in fact matching the lowest we have tracked at Amazon all year.

There were some wild prices on these during the Black Friday deal season in late 2025 and we might very well see deals like that later this year as well, but if you missed out on the Memorial Day offer and are looking to land a set now for this summer, the Amazon 2026 low has returned once again. At the time of writing, Best Buy and most other authorized retailers are asking for the full $129 on them right now.

This week’s best Apple deals have been dominated by the 2026 M5 MacBook Air, and if you’re eyeing a new Cupertino notebook for the summer as well, Amazon all-time low pricing is at the ready with as much as $199 slashed from the list prices right now on various configurations:

Looking to refresh your Apple Magic Mouse? Amazon has it at all-time low pricing right now

Nomad’s nicest brown Horween leather iPhone cases and Watch bands now on sale: Buy 2 save 15%

Spigen’s Athlex Air delivers that Trail Loop Apple Watch band vibe for just $20

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker’s latest summer road trip-ready 25W MagSafe car mount charger now 25% off at Amazon
  • Anker 140W 4-port Laptop Charger with smart display is down to $60 low today
  • UGREEN’s all-new 65W Nexode Air is among the smallest chargers we’ve seen, now down to a new low at just $25
  • You can maintain clean PCs, peripherals, furniture, car seating, and more with this GOOLOO F3 air duster at its $30 low
  • The latest Anker eufy C31 indoor & outdoor security camera + 2-pack are down at Amazon lows from $48
  • Govee’s new portable Lightwall with Matter + over 200 scenes gets its first discount to $400
  • Just $15 today gets you this 15W wireless car mount charger with a 3.3-foot USB-C cable (54% off)
  • Top off your iPhone, iPad, MacBook Neo, more in ‘over 150 countries’ with this travel adapter, now $18
  • New metal dual-network SmartCard Pro debuts with wireless charging, metal frame, and 2-year battery life
  • Longer, faster, and more powerful 240W Beats braided USB-C cables nearly 30% off today

Apple’s iPhone Air MagSafe Battery is sitting at its best price ever right now (40% off)

Alongside the all-time pricing still live on Apple’s most affordable M5 MacBook Air, another of the most notable Memorial Day hangover deals has the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery sitting at its best price ever with 40% in savings at Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery at $59 shipped. Regularly $99, it is still sitting at the Amazon all-time low with 40% slashed from the list price to deliver the best deal we have tracked to date. This is indeed the Memorial Day deal so there’s no telling how much longer it will stick around for.

While mostly holding strong at the full $99 for Q4 2025 shortly after release last September alongside iPhone Air, 2026 started to usher in some significant deals. From mid-January through to mid March we saw repeating drops to $80 or so before the May spring sales saw new all-time lows at $60. And now, it is slightly lower for the best deal we have tracked to date.

There are more compact and more affordable options out there, but if you ask me this is the most elegant portable charging solution for iPhone Air users. It does also work with other gear, but it is tailored-made for Apple’s ultra-thin handset, delivering 65% extra battery life and proper iOS battery widget integration in one of the thinnest MagSafe power banks on the market.

Most affordable M4 iPad Air models you can buy return to Amazon lows from $520 (Up to $109 off)

While some of the Memorial Day Apple deals have come and gone now, the latest M4 iPad Air lineup is actually seeing the return of all-time low pricing on some of the most affordable configurations. We spotted the base 13-inch hitting a new all-time low at $99 off yesterday (still live), but the 128GB and 256GB 11-inch models have also dropped back to the best prices to date as well.

Amazon is now offering the 128GB 11-inch M4 iPad Air down at $519.99 shipped. Regularly $599, that’s $79 off and on par with the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon since release.

Much of the same applies to the 256GB 11-inch model as well. Regularly $699, you’ll now find select colors on this configuration sitting down at $609.99 shipped to match the lowest price we have tracked for this one.

As is usually the case in the early days of the iPad Air launch cycle, the price drops are quite steep on the lesser expensive variants. But we are nonetheless getting another chance at the best deals to date on this two options.

Down below you’ll find an updated rundown of the best deals across the lineup. Those interested in the 13-inch form-actor will want to direct their attention to the two most affordable models – the 128GB is at a new Amazon low at $99 off and the 256GB has returned to its best price at $109 off:

M4 iPad Air 11-inch

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $520 (Reg. $599)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $610 (Reg. $699)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $839 (Reg. $899)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,019 (Reg. $1,099)
